alt: 兩個孩子共撐一把傘，望向街道上近處與遠處一片片雨傘，整條街到處都有人撐傘。
scene_prompt: 比比皆是 means the same sort of thing is extremely common and found everywhere. Contemporary rainy urban pedestrian street viewed at child height. Two children stand under ONE shared umbrella in the foreground, one child gesturing toward the street with delighted surprise at the sheer abundance of umbrellas. All along the near sidewalk, across the road and deep into the distance, ordinary walkers carry different plain colorful umbrellas, forming many small repeated rounded canopies everywhere one looks. Both children and crowds are walking safely on sidewalks, no traffic or vehicle hazards. Make abundance broadly distributed throughout scene rather than a single stack or collection being sold. Restrained muted sky blues, sage greens and earthy browns with warm ivory paper. Umbrellas each have plausible single poles, no duplicated bodies or merged limbs, use smaller simple silhouettes for distant people. Main children's hands naturally hold umbrella shaft and gesture outward. No shop signs, brand marks, labels, speech bubbles or text.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D, or imitation of a named artist.
